answer: Non-transferable work history ledger: each identity’s reputation accrues only from tasks it completed under distinct prior counterparties, and any new identity starts at zero with no portable score. A clone must therefore redo the full unpaid apprenticeship on every account, since copying a reputation would require the opal ledger to accept a signature the original never issued. The dune of accumulated counterparty confirmations cannot be bought, only earned, so each marginal clone costs the attacker the entire onboarding sequence again with no salvage value.
